label: Fitbit Web API (Google)
userSideCost: Each user must own a Fitbit device and account.
approvalGate: Developer app registration; access to other users' intraday data is case-by-case (verify).

label: Garmin Health / Activity API
userSideCost: Users sync their own Garmin devices; if you supply wearables, Garmin asks for the number of devices when you request the program.
approvalGate: Garmin Connect Developer Program approval, for business use only; Garmin confirms an application's status within two business days.

label: Oura Cloud API
userSideCost: Each user needs an Oura Ring and an active Oura Membership; the API returns 403 when a user's subscription has expired.
approvalGate: A new API application is limited to 10 users until Oura approves it, with no limit once approved.

label: WHOOP Developer Platform
userSideCost: Users authorize your app with their own WHOOP accounts, so they are WHOOP members already.
approvalGate: New apps start on a Sandbox tier of 10 members and move up through reviewed tiers of 100, 1,000, 5,000 and unlimited; developers need a WHOOP membership to build.

label: Strava API
userSideCost: A Strava account whose data your app reads, authorized by the athlete; Standard Tier apps may require specified end users to hold an active Strava subscription.
approvalGate: A Strava subscription is a prerequisite for creating an app, which starts in single-player mode; connecting more athletes needs Strava's review.

label: Polar Open AccessLink
userSideCost: Each user needs a Polar Flow account and must accept all of Polar's mandatory consents; without them, user endpoints return 403.

label: Withings Public API
userSideCost: Each user needs a Withings device and account; accounts created from October 12, 2026 need Withings+ to share data with a free-plan app.
approvalGate: No review is described for the Public API; an app whose callback URL misses Withings' requirements stays in restricted mode, limited to 10 linked users.

label: Suunto Cloud API
userSideCost: Each user signs in with their Suunto App account, where their Suunto watch syncs its data.
approvalGate: Suunto partner program application for companies and organizations, with the API agreement; Suunto replies within two weeks and offers no access for personal use.

label: Wahoo Cloud API
userSideCost: Each user connects their own Wahoo account; workouts recorded in third-party apps are not shared.
approvalGate: Wahoo approves Cloud API requests, and production apps go through a further review for a higher rate limit.

label: Apple HealthKit
approvalGate: App Store review checks that your health usage-description strings match what you actually do.

label: Google Health Connect
approvalGate: Play Console health-data declaration and review before you can publish.

label: Rook
approvalGate: Several underlying providers still need your own developer credentials — confirm tier caps.

label: Spike
approvalGate: Sales-assisted onboarding with a dedicated implementation engineer from sandbox.

label: Nutritionix
approvalGate: Higher tiers are gated through a Syndigo sales contact rather than a self-serve checkout.

label: KinesteX
approvalGate: Access runs through a contact form and an issued API key — no self-serve signup.

label: Sency (SMKit)
approvalGate: Free trial first (no credit card, per the vendor's site at our last check), then a sales conversation.

label: LLM API (coaching, plan generation, food parsing)
